verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph exposes a broad API surface for OneDrive covering file CRUD, upload sessions, sharing links, search, versioning, delta/change tracking, and thumbnails, which maps to most core UI actions. However, some UI-specific experiences like real-time coauthoring in Office apps and Files On-Demand offline toggling are not clearly exposed as equivalent API operations, and there's no independent verification (e.g., OpenAPI spec) confirming full API-UI parity. missing for 10: API equivalents for real-time coauthoring/Office app integration, Files On-Demand offline controls via API, independent/hands-on confirmation of full parity, machine-readable OpenAPI spec.
